```python
import csv

import numpy as np

with open(
    "code/data/monthly-orders-time-series.csv",
    encoding="utf-8",
) as source:
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(source))

orders = np.array([float(row["orders"]) for row in rows])
history = orders[:36].tolist()
actual_control = orders[36:]
forecasts = {
    "Наивный": [],
    "Сезонный": [],
    "С дрейфом": [],
    "Средняя (3)": [],
}

for actual in actual_control:
    forecasts["Наивный"].append(history[-1])
    forecasts["Сезонный"].append(history[-12])
    mean_change = (history[-1] - history[0]) / (len(history) - 1)
    forecasts["С дрейфом"].append(history[-1] + mean_change)
    forecasts["Средняя (3)"].append(np.mean(history[-3:]))
    history.append(actual)

for method, values in forecasts.items():
    errors = actual_control - np.array(values)
    mae = np.mean(np.abs(errors))
    rmse = np.sqrt(np.mean(errors**2))
    mape = 100 * np.mean(np.abs(errors / actual_control))
    print(
        f"{method:12s} MAE={mae:5.1f}; "
        f"RMSE={rmse:5.1f}; MAPE={mape:4.1f}%"
    )
```
